name: Mekgineer Thermaplugg can be taunted
contract: Issue #9673: Mekgineer Thermaplugg (7800) kept stock AzerothCore's immunity row -230, whose NO_TAUNT flag, Attack Me
effect and Bind aura make him immune to taunts. He now uses row -229 like the other Gnomeregan bosses, the same
mechanic immunities without taunt immunity. Blood Howl 800782 is a taunt (aura 11 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TAUNT on enemies
within 10 yards); it lands on him and puts him in combat with the taunter. Fear is still among his immunities.

steps.label: Blood Howl's taunt lands on Thermaplugg
